contract.bound_method_registration: EventBus accepts bound instance methods as callbacks
contract.bound_method_identity: Callback identity is based on bound-method instance and underlying function
contract.bound_method_unregister: A registered bound method can be removed using a freshly accessed bound-method object representing the same instance and function
contract.last_listener_removal: Removing the last listener removes the event entry from the registry
contract.post_unregister_delivery: Events emitted after unregister succeed without invoking the removed callback
contract.permission_enforcement: Register and unregister operations require the plugin events permission
contract.registry_stability: Unregister does not leave a stale listener entry
